title: OriginalCapturedSalienceSourceStageManifest
description:
Distinct mandatory original-capture ancestry, not a numerical qualification.
Old Declared lineage is preserved, never silently promoted or unwrapped.

original_capture.description: Required standalone original-A forward salience capture run/span/root.

BlobId.description: Content identity for stored tensor or asset bytes.

EvidenceReference.description: Evidence ancestry reference, not a self-approved quality/release verdict.

root.description: BLAKE3 evidence root, not a blob id or package digest.

run.description: Run identity of the evidence producer.

NamedAssetDigest.description: Exact named asset-content binding in the candidate model preimage.

content.description: Exact stored asset-content digest, not a shard/package identity.

name.description: Asset basename; names affect model semantics.

OriginalSourceId.description: Candidate identity of original named tensor/asset content, not fitted content or provenance.

QuantSourceBinding.description: Actual original raw tensor-byte binding computed by the engine itself.

content.description: BLAKE3 of exact original raw bytes; not original container/HF identity.

QuantSourceTensor.description: Original tensor interpretation, never an adapter-supplied content hash.

precision.description: Original stored float precision, before widening or fitting.

shape.description: Positive row-major dimensions in the original source.

SalienceInverseAxis.description: Explicit axis of the graph partner divided by each stored scale.

oneOf.description: Rank-one preceding norm, one channel per projection input column.
Rank-two linear partner, one output row per projection input column.

SalienceMomentBinding.description: Exact actual moment content plus explicitly declared interpretation.

channels.description: One moment per projection input column and partner output channel.

content.description: BLAKE3 of row-major little-endian f64 second-moment sums, not an activation hash.

rows.description: Declared positive sample count; not proof of observed row execution.

SalienceNumerics.description: Ordered numerical semantics, never an implicit recipe fallback.

oneOf.description: Legacy ordered f64 RMS/log-mean/powf, f32 cast and multiply/divide.

SalienceOperationOutput.description: Actual stored scales for one executed pair; bits are JSON-safe byte arrays.

operation.description: Exact operation name in executed order.

scale_bits.description: Actual finite positive f32 scale bits, in channel order.

SalienceSourceStageManifest.description: Mandatory typed B stage manifest, distinct from a fitted model manifest.

observation.description: Complete observation; agreement with log/actual bytes is checked separately.

schema.description: The only admitted candidate metadata version is 1.0.

SalienceStatisticsKind.description: What the statistics observation actually establishes.

oneOf.description: Supplied moments/rows only; no claim of executed graph/token/teacher capture.

SalienceTransformLimits.description: Logical payload/numeric-vector budgets, not process RSS admission.

max_derived_bytes.description: Complete derived tensor payload total, including touched tensors widened to F32.

max_pair_working_bytes.description: Pair decoded vectors, replacement bytes and RMS/scales; excludes metadata and RSS.

max_source_bytes.description: Complete consumed original tensor payload total.

max_statistics_bytes.description: Complete supplied moment vectors, in raw f64 bytes.

SalienceTransformObservation.description: Actual complete source-stage observation, not a sealed log or release receipt.

derived_source.description: Actual produced complete B identity, using the same raw-content domain.

derived_tensors.description: Actual complete derived tensor raw-content/dtype bindings.

original_tensors.description: Actual complete original tensor raw-content bindings.

plan.description: Executed request, explicitly declaring statistics rather than captured-graph truth.

SalienceTransformOperation.description: One ordered, named paired operation; names do not prove graph eligibility.

alpha_bits.description: Exact little-endian f64 alpha bits, including signed zero.

inverse.description: Distinct norm/linear partner whose channels/output rows are divided.

inverse_axis.description: Explicit partner interpretation; no inference from tensor naming.

moments.description: Exact expected statistics and declared count interpretation.

name.description: Unique logical operation name, used to select the actual statistics.

projections.description: Actual matrices whose input columns are multiplied, in declared order.

SalienceTransformPlan.description: Candidate complete source-stage request, not a captured-statistics qualification.

architecture.description: Original source architecture identifier; execution admission is separate.

assets.description: Complete strictly sorted unchanged asset basenames.

limits.description: Explicit logical bounds; no out-of-core/full-memory claim follows.

operations.description: Order is significant, e.g. up input columns before up output rows.

original_source.description: Observed expected A identity; the controller must derive its own consumed identity.

statistics_kind.description: Initial profile must stay Declared until an executed capture is admitted.

tensors.description: Complete strictly sorted original tensor interpretations.

ScalePrecision.description: Precision used to store additive plane scales.

SchemaId.description: Stable identifier for a schema family and its version.

major.description: Major version; incompatible schemas require a new major version.

minor.description: Minor version; additive compatible schema evolution increments this.
